title: Practice 13: до, после, около, мимо, кроме, вместо, против…

blocks.text: Exercises: sentences from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR) and from the library's public-domain books.

exercises.q: Думаю, если ты мне подсобишь, я смогу дотянуться до ___ (ветка).
exercises.prompt: I think I can reach the branch if you'll give me a boost.
exercises.why: до — before, till, until, to, up to. из — from, out of. из-за — from behind; because of. из-под — from under. кроме — besides, except. мимо — past, by. около — near. от — from. после — after. против — opposite, against. с — from, since. у — by, near, at. — From the DLI Grammar Reference Book. Lesson 60.  ·  «List of prepositions which are followed by the genitive case: без, вдоль, вместо, для, до, из, из-за, из-под, кроме, мимо, около, от, после, против, с, у.» — DLI, Lesson 60.
exercises.context: до — before, till, until, to, up to.

exercises.q: Иногда среди ___ (разговор) он вдруг угрюмо задумывался.
exercises.why: The genitive case has four main uses: to denote possession ('Michael's car', meaning 'the car of Michael'), to denote number ('five apples'), in negative constructions ('there are no books'), and after several important prepositions ('without me'). — From the Wikibooks Russian textbook (CC BY-SA 4.0).
